events.name: Jurassic Quest – Eugene, OR | Lane County Events Center
events.description:
The Ultimate Family Adventure!
Jurassic Quest — the world’s most popular dinosaur experience — is now the ultimate event for LEGO®  brick builders and fans.  Get ready for the ULTIMATE day of discovery, play, and imagination!
Dino Fans: Step into the age of dinosaurs and marvel at life-size, moving giants — including the towering Apatosaurus, colossal Spinosaurus, and legendary T. rex. Enjoy hands-on fossil digs, meet adorable baby dinos, and hop on thrilling dino rides.
Brick Fans: Unleash your imagination with massive LEGO-inspired sculptures, build your own designs, explore interactive play zones, and race your custom build in the wildly popular Brick Derby!
One weekend only and one ticket gets it all — grab your tickets now before they’re gone!

events.name: Hazlett
events.info: Hazlett is hosting "The Pre-Show Speakeasy" before the concert for a small handful of people... "The Pre-Show Speakeasy" features: - Early entry into the venue - Solo acoustic performance by Hazlett - Question time & Chats with Hazlett - Commemorative Pre-Show Laminate & a little autographed gift - First access to merch shopping & vinyl signing "The Pre-Show Speakeasy" is now available as an add-on purchase to all ticket holders... "The Pre-Show Speakeasy" add-on does NOT include a ticket to the show. Purchasers of the preshow add-on must also have a ticket purchased, under the same name, for entry into the preshow event and the show following. Purchaser info will be shared with Hazlett's team for coordination. Package details subject to change without notice. All preshow packages are NON-TRANSFERABLE; NO NAME CHANGES will be permitted under any circumstances; NO REFUNDS or EXCHANGES; all sales are final. Please note this offer is not valid for tickets purchased via Fan to Fan Resale. By participating in any event with Hazlett you hereby agree that your name, photographic and/or video image, and voice may be used in any media, whether now known or hereafter invented, throughout the world for any purpose whatsoever. Non-ticket package elements will be subject to the non-transferable restrictions listed above. You will receive an email 2-3 days prior to the performance date with instructions on how to redeem your Preshow Speakeasy tickets. Additional communication regarding your purchase may be sent via SMS text message to the phone number you provided during the purchase process. Preshow programming will take place up to 1 hour before doors. Exclusive gift items will be distributed on-site at the preshow event. If merchandise is distributed on-site, we cannot ship your items if you choose not to pick them up. By purchasing a preshow event package, you agree to share your information with Hazlett's team in order to receive communications regarding your preshow tickets.
